note: English translation of basics_dev.json for models that understand Russian poorly (Nemotron, 2026-11-12). Same ids, starts, references, volumes and answers; only the prompts are translated. Source note: Sweep, loft, taper, rib, angled hole, combine, move, text (tunable set, 2026-11-02). Volumes by hand where a formula exists; null = held by size.

cases.prompt: Make a tube with an outer diameter of 10 mm and a 6 mm bore along the path: from point (0, 0) to (60, 0), then to (60, 40), in the XY plane, bend radius 15 mm.
Make a rod 8 mm in diameter bent into an L shape: 50 mm along X, then 30 mm up along Z, from point (0, 0, 0), bend radius 10 mm.
Make a spring: wire 2 mm, mean diameter 20 mm, pitch 6 mm, 5 turns.
Make an adapter: at the bottom a circle 40 mm in diameter at height 0, at the top a 30 by 30 mm square at a height of 50 mm, solid.
cases.reference:
sk1 = new_sketch('XY', offset=0)
circle(sk1, 0, 0, 40)
sk2 = new_sketch('XY', offset=50)
rect_center(sk2, 0, 0, 30, 30)
loft([sk1, sk2])

cases.prompt: Make a truncated cone: base diameter 40 mm, top diameter 20 mm, height 30 mm.

Make a plate 60 by 40 mm, 5 mm thick; at its left short edge (x = 0) a wall 5 mm thick and 30 mm high, and between the plate and the wall, in the middle, a gusset: 20 mm along the plate, 20 mm along the wall, 4 mm thick.
cases.reference:
box(60, 40, 5, corner=(0, 0, 0))
box(5, 40, 30, corner=(0, 0, 5), operation='join')
gusset(20, 20, 4, corner=(5, 20, 5), along='X')

cases.prompt: Make a block 60 by 40 mm, 20 mm high, and drill a through hole 6 mm in diameter in it, tilted 30 degrees from vertical, entering at the center of the top face.
Make a block 50 by 50 mm, 30 mm high, and a separate sphere 20 mm in diameter with its center on the axis, 30 mm above the bottom of the block, then subtract the sphere from the block.
Make a 20 mm cube at the origin, make a copy of it shifted 40 mm along X, and join both into one body with a 20 by 10 mm bridge, 5 mm thick, lying in the gap between them at the bottom.
cases.reference:
box(20, 20, 20, corner=(0, 0, 0))
copy_body('Body1', dx=40)
box(20, 10, 5, corner=(20, 5, 0), operation='join')

cases.prompt: Make a plate 80 by 30 mm, 3 mm thick, and cut the text "AB" into its top: letters 15 mm high, 1 mm deep, starting at point (10, 8).
Make a square tube 10 by 10 mm with a 2 mm wall, bent along a quarter-circle arc of radius 40 mm in the XY plane: from point (40, 0, 0) to point (0, 40, 0), arc center at the origin.

Make a bracket: base 80 by 40 mm, 8 mm thick; at the back edge (y = 0) an upright 10 mm thick, 30 mm wide, centered, 60 mm high; on top of the upright a lug 40 mm in diameter, 10 mm thick, with a horizontal 22 mm hole, axis along Y, the lug center 20 mm above the top of the upright.
cases.reference:
box(80, 40, 8, corner=(0, 0, 0))
box(30, 10, 60, corner=(25, 0, 8), operation='join')
lug(40, 22, 10, center=(40, 5, 88), axis='Y')

cases.prompt: Make a plate 6 mm thick with this outline: the back edge straight from (0, 40) to (60, 40), the side edges straight, the front corners are round lobes of radius 8 mm with centers (8, 8) and (52, 8), and between the lobes the front edge curves inward in an arc from (16, 8) through (30, 16) to (44, 8).

Make an upright plate 8 mm thick: at the bottom it stands on the line from x = 0 to x = 60 at height 0, at the top it ends in a lug 30 mm in diameter with a 16 mm hole, lug center (30, 0, 60), hole axis along Y; the sides of the plate are tangent to the lug circle.
cases.volume: ((60 + 2*((30 + 15*math.cos(math.atan2(-60, 30) + math.acos(15/math.hypot(30, 60)))) - 30))/2*(60 + 15*math.sin(math.atan2(-60, 30) + math.acos(15/math.hypot(30, 60)))) + 225*math.acos(((60 + 15*math.sin(math.atan2(-60, 30) + math.acos(15/math.hypot(30, 60)))) - 60)/15) - ((60 + 15*math.sin(math.atan2(-60, 30) + math.acos(15/math.hypot(30, 60)))) - 60)*math.sqrt(225 - ((60 + 15*math.sin(math.atan2(-60, 30) + math.acos(15/math.hypot(30, 60)))) - 60)**2) - math.pi*8*8)*8

cases.prompt: Make a plate 60 by 40 mm, 6 mm thick; on it, flush with the back edge, stands a wall 8 mm thick (y from 32 to 40) across the full width, 50 mm high above the plate; on the front face of the wall two leaning ribs 5 mm thick: each 20 mm along the plate and 40 mm along the wall, the rib feet 15 mm from the side edges (x = 15 and x = 45), the top of each rib shifted 10 mm toward the middle.
cases.reference:
box(60, 40, 6, corner=(0, 0, 0))
box(60, 8, 50, corner=(0, 32, 6), operation='join')
gusset(20, 40, 5, corner=(15, 32, 6), lean=10)
gusset(20, 40, 5, corner=(45, 32, 6), lean=-10)
